product.description: Monoprice™11‑in‑1 USB‑C® Triple 4K60 Display Docking Station with DP 1.4 Alt Mode SupportEffortlessly Boost Your Workflow with Triple Display Connectivity, Lightning‑Fast 10Gbps Data Transfers, Reliable Gigabit Ethernet, Dual Card Readers for Easy Media Access, and Powerful Charging Capabilities‑All Designed to Deliver Seamless ProductivityDiscover the power and versatility of the Monoprice 11‑in‑1 USB‑C Triple‑Display Docking Station, designed to transform your workstation into a hub of productivity and connectivity. This advanced docking station is perfect for modern professionals and tech enthusiasts who demand seamless multitasking, offering triple video output with support for DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode and MST (Multi‑Stream Transport). Effortlessly extend your display across three monitors‑two via HDMI® and one via DisplayPort‑making it perfect for design, analytics, gaming, and business applications.Connectivity is never compromised, thanks to the docking station's comprehensive suite of ports, including two high-speed USB-A ports and one USB‑C port (all supporting 10Gbps transfer rates), Gigabit Ethernet for reliable wired networking, SD™ and microSD™ card slots for quick media access, and a 3.5mm audio jack for high‑quality sound. The robust DC power input delivers up to 134W, ensuring your devices stay charged and ready for action, while built‑in security lock slots keep your setup secure.Engineered for compatibility with USB‑C and Thunderbolt™ devices that support DP Alt Mode, this dock ensures smooth performance for both Windows® and Mac® users. With support for HDR video, multiple color formats, and high‑resolution displays up to 4K, your visuals shine with vivid clarity. Additional features like Wake‑on‑LAN, dual card slot operation, and downstream charging further enhance productivity. The Monoprice 11‑in‑1 Docking Station is your all‑in‑one solution for expanding workspace capabilities‑simply connect and experience exceptional convenience and performance.Supports triple video
